name: cg_exchange_info
description:
Details of one spot exchange from CoinGecko (exchanges/{id}): name, country, year established, URLs, trust score and rank, 24h BTC volume, and its top tickers.
Returns CoinGecko's exchange object, including a tickers array.
Inputs (* required): id* (string, CoinGecko exchange id such as binance, gdax (Coinbase Exchange) or kraken; ids come from cg_exchanges_list).
For all trading pairs of the exchange use cg_exchange_tickers.
Example: {"id": "kraken"}
